subject: Life Skills
title: How Misinformation Spreads
description: A fast breakdown of How Misinformation Spreads for builders.

hook.text: MIT found that false news spreads six times faster than true news on social media.

buildup.text: Surprising or emotional content triggers sharing. Outrage and fear travel faster than calm facts.

discovery.text: Algorithms prioritize engagement, not truth. Viral lies get shown to more people than boring facts.

twist.text: People share headlines without reading articles. The headline alone shapes belief and drives outrage.

climax.text: Before sharing, read the full article, check the source, and pause to let emotion settle.

punchline.text: If it makes you furious, fact-check first.

quiz.question: Why does false news spread faster than true news?
options: It comes from more trustworthy sources
